text.en:
Project No. (128), page 24-A, Title A, Appendix A of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred, is amended to read as follows:
"(128) Bibak Students GOB 80.00 (80.00) (80.00) Construction."
Dormitory including purchase of equipment Baguio City:

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
